title: CHLR CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE 100 LBS

onscreen_lines.desc: CHLORINE CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE, GRANULAR 100 LBS - SHIPPING MUST BE INCLUDED IN PRICE. EXPANDED DESCRIPTION: UN2880 CALCIUM HYPOCHLORITE HYDRATED MIXTURES, PG II, 5.1 Minimum Specifications Product shall be Calcium Hypochlorite, granular form. Minimum 65% available chlorine content. Appearance shall be white to light gray. Product shall be classified as: UN2880 Calcium Hypochlorite Hydrated Mixtures Packaging Group II (PG II) Hazard Class 5.1 (Oxidizer) Supplied in moisture-resistant packaging with a total net weight of 100 pounds per container. Product shall be suitable for municipal water treatment and disinfection applications. Vendor shall provide a current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) with shipment. Vendor shall provide manufacturer documentation verifying compliance with the specified chlorine content and product quality standards.
